## History

Patty is an elderly woman who inherited her home, Patty's Place, through her brother Aaron's will, having never previously visited or expected to visit [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). Prior to turning seventy, she and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) agreed to rent the cottage to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) so that the two women could travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) for a year. Their departure allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends to move into the house for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_
